bugs.goal: Preserve valid client-viewer association and role-scoped access during account edits.

Review report monetary totals and campaign table.
bugs.expected: Reports retain supported two-decimal monetary precision; 10.25 remains visible.
bugs.actual: App money formatter maximumFractionDigits:0 renders 10 instead of10.25.

bugs.goal: Display entered financial amounts without discarding currency fractions.
bugs.description: Executed RTL reproduction demonstrates report formatter rounds spend 10.25 to 10. Correct shared money formatting across totals, report rows and monetary cost ratios while retaining locale and client currency.

Input 10.25 remains visibly 10.25 (or locale-equivalent 10,25), including small nonzero amounts.

bugs.title: Alembic ignores project .env DATABASE_URL during setup
reproduction_steps: Copy migration scripts to disposable project directory; write .env DATABASE_URL pointing to temp configured.sqlite3.
Write temp Alembic config with different temp fallback.sqlite3 and repository import path.
Remove DATABASE_URL only from subprocess environment; run python -m alembic -c temporary-config upgrade head.
bugs.expected: Migration creates configured.sqlite3 from project .env, matching documented runtime configuration.
bugs.actual: Migration exits0 but configured.sqlite3 absent and fallback.sqlite3 created.
bugs.impact: Custom .env DB setup migrates wrong file; runtime can then refuse startup due missing schema.
bugs.evidence: 2026-10-19 independent targetedpytest exit1: configured database absent after successful migration. Separate filesystem inspection confirms fallback exists. Root .env/defaultDB were never edited.

pm_grooming.basis: QA observed test_qa_setup.py exit1: migration0, configuredDBfalse/fallbackDBtrue in disposable copied project.
pm_grooming.publication: pending_publish; no external GitHub issue exists.

bugs.goal: Make documented migrations and runtime use the same configured database.
bugs.description: Observed disposable-project test shows Alembic ignores root .env DATABASE_URL while runtime loads it: migration exits0 creating fallback database, leaving intended database unmigrated. Load root dotenv consistently with runtime while preserving process-environment precedence.
acceptance_criteria: With DATABASE_URL only in disposable project root .env, Alembic upgrade head creates schema in configured database and does not create fallback database.
Explicit subprocess DATABASE_URL overrides .env value, consistent with runtime configuration.
Regression test uses temporary copied migration/config/project files and never edits real root .env or user database.
Run independent setup reproduction and affected migration/backend regression suite; preserve actual commands/results.
Documented setup instructions migrate the same database runtime opens.
bugs.out_of_scope: New runtime features, production deployment and unrelated configuration changes.
bugs.constraints: Follow runtime dotenv precedence; no secrets in git, no edits to real root.env or user database. Keep migration history and frozen API contract.
